listings.name: Chuan Spa at The Langham, Chicago
listings.description: Chuan Spa at The Langham, Chicago provides a comprehensive thermal experience centered on its multiple sauna facilities. Spa-goers consistently note the properly hot temperatures of both the saunas and steam room, which meet expectations for an effective heat session. The venue offers a herbal sauna, a dry sauna, and a Himalayan salt room, providing variety for guests. These amenities are part of a dedicated wet and dry sauna area that guests can use before treatments. The spa also features a relaxation lounge with heated loungers for post-sauna recovery. While the reviews contain no mention of a cold plunge or contrast therapy, the thermal amenities are a highlighted feature of the experience.This award-winning spa occupies an entire floor and emphasizes traditional Chinese medicine, offering over 40 treatments including acupuncture and moxibustion. The spa experience often includes a multi-step journey. Guests frequently praise the high-quality customized massages and facials, with specific therapists like Leslie and Christine receiving notable acclaim for their skill. The beautiful, clean, and tranquil atmosphere is a major draw, complemented by amenities such as an indoor pool and hot tub. The venue is considered a premium destination for special occasions, though some guests note challenges with booking communication and occasional inconsistencies in service and cleanliness standards at the front desk and with robes.

listings.name: Contrast Hot + Cold
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers Chicago's first communal hot and cold therapy studio, providing an effective contrast therapy experience. The venue features several large infrared saunas and dedicated cold plunge tubs in its main community space. Spa-goers frequently highlight the quality of the sauna and cold plunge, noting the sauna is perfectly relaxing and the cold plunge is super refreshing. The infrared saunas are also noted to include red light therapy. Guests can choose between the open community area or private rooms equipped with 1-2 person infrared saunas and cold plunges for a more personal session. The contrast therapy is praised for its recovery benefits, helping with inflammation, muscle soreness, and overall performance for athletes and those with physical soreness.AtmosphereThe facility is described as absolutely beautiful, well-designed, and having a great vibe. The main community space allows guests a chance to meet new people, which contributes to the positive and social atmosphere. The overall environment is considered perfect for recovery and relaxation.StaffThe staff is consistently noted as friendly, knowledgeable, supportive, and welcoming. Specific owners and team members, including Braxton, Doug, and Brad, are mentioned by name for being helpful, coaching guests through best practices, and ensuring visitors get the most out of each session.Additional AmenitiesThe primary amenities focus on the contrast therapy experience. The spa provides all necessary items for timing sauna and cold plunge intervals. The infrared saunas incorporate red light therapy, which guests find awesome.

listings.name: Copper Wellness
listings.description: Copper Wellness is a premier holistic wellness center in Chicago that combines modern techniques with time-honored practices. The spa provides a personalized and integrative approach to health and well-being through a team of integrative medicine doctors and experienced medical practitioners. Guests consistently describe the environment as calming, welcoming, and filled with positive energy, with specific appreciation for details like the candles in the lobby.Spa-goers report transformative wellness experiences, particularly through acupuncture treatments provided by Dr. Stephanie Madden and Dr. Mohr. These providers are noted as exceptional, knowledgeable, and kind, offering personalized treatment plans that effectively address a wide range of concerns. Common outcomes highlighted by guests include significant relief from pain—such as lower back, hip, and SI joint pain—as well as improved management of stress, anxiety, hormone health, digestion, and sleep. The practice also offers therapeutic massage, with Benicia noted as one of the best massage therapists. The overall experience is described as leaving guests feeling more balanced and cared for, though some guests have reported issues with billing transparency, delayed insurance claims, and customer service related to these matters.

listings.name: Eastend
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa specializes in contrast therapy, the practice of alternating between sauna sessions and cold plunges. Spa-goers consistently highlight the rejuvenating and recovery benefits of this core offering, noting it helps with muscle recovery, improved circulation, stress reduction, and enhanced sleep quality. Guests appreciate the guided group sauna sessions and report feeling amazing after their sessions, with some managing to stay in the cold plunge for two to three minutes. The experience is designed to be a sanctuary for recovery, particularly favored by those training for endurance events like marathons.AtmosphereEastend is noted for its exquisite and beautifully maintained space with a modern loft vibe. They take time to explain the process and the different services available, ensuring guests can safely maximize their session.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the core contrast therapy, the spa offers a salt room that guests find beneficial for respiratory wellness. Additional services include red light therapy, described as cozy and meditative and noted for helping with conditions like psoriasis, and chromatherapy, which is highlighted as a unique offering in the Midwest. The venue also hosts events, such as group runs followed by contrast therapy sessions.

listings.name: Airie Apartments
